en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a densely packed street procession through a European historic town. Hundreds of people line a narrow cobblestone street bordered by multi‑story masonry buildings with shutters and arcades. In the foreground and middle distance are clergy in vestments, acolytes, and lay participants, suggesting a Catholic religious procession or funeral. At the far end of the street stands a church façade with a bell/clock tower rising behind it. The architecture appears early‑modern Italian, with stuccoed walls, arched porticoes, and wooden window shutters.
